question: Who won India's first-ever gold medal in the Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Anwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashid Anwar** was the first Indian to win a medal at the **Commonwealth Games** (then known as the British Empire Games). He secured a **bronze medal in wrestling** in the **1934 London Games**.
 
• His achievement marked the beginning of India's journey in the Commonwealth Games, making him a significant figure in Indian sports history.
 
• The **1934 British Empire Games** were held in London, where Rashid Anwar showcased exceptional skill in wrestling and earned recognition for India on an international platform.
 
• India's participation in the Commonwealth Games began in **1934**, and Rashid Anwar's medal was a source of national pride, especially during the pre-independence era.
 
• His contribution to Indian wrestling paved the way for future athletes to excel in the sport and inspire generations to compete at international levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Milkha Singh:**

 
 
• Known as the "Flying Sikh," **Milkha Singh** was a legendary Indian sprinter who represented India in multiple international events, including the Olympics.
 
• He did not win a Commonwealth Games medal but is remembered for his extraordinary performance in the **1958 Cardiff Commonwealth Games**, where he secured **India's first gold medal in athletics**.
 
 
 
• **Karnam Malleswari:**
 
 
• **Karnam Malleswari** is a celebrated Indian weightlifter and the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal (bronze in the **2000 Sydney Olympics**).
 
• She did not win a Commonwealth Games gold medal but remains a trailblazer in weightlifting for women in India.
 
 
 
• **Mirabai Chanu:**
 
 
• **Mirabai Chanu**, an Indian weightlifter, won the gold medal in the **2022 Commonwealth Games** in Birmingham in the **49 kg weightlifting category**.
 
• She is widely recognized for her achievements in weightlifting, including a silver medal at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games:**
 
 
• The **Commonwealth Games** are an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• India has been participating in the Commonwealth Games since **1934** and has won numerous medals across various sports disciplines.
 
• The Games are held every four years and feature sports that reflect the cultural heritage of the Commonwealth countries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Achievements at the Commonwealth Games:**

 
 
• India has won over **500 medals** at the Commonwealth Games, spanning disciplines such as wrestling, weightlifting, shooting, and athletics.
 
• The country's success at the Games highlights its sporting prowess and commitment to developing athletes for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• Rashid Anwar's achievement in **1934** was significant as it came during India's colonial period, showcasing the potential of Indian athletes on global platforms.
 
• His bronze medal in wrestling marked the beginning of India's medal journey at the Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Influence on Wrestling in India:**
 
 
• Rashid Anwar's success inspired future generations of Indian wrestlers to excel in the sport.
 
• India has since become a dominant force in wrestling at the Commonwealth Games, winning numerous medals in various weight categories.
